notes: Null because the awarding body's mark is not served from this host, and the marks that ARE served here belong to a different body. Read the full markup of the stored page (HTTP 200, Drupal 10). The page's own text states the awarders: 'El Centro Maria Sibylla Merian de Estudios Latinoamericanos Avanzados (CALAS) y la Universidad de Bielefeld estan aceptando solicitudes para dos becas', and it routes applications and further information to http://calas.lat/es/node/4062 and http://calas.lat/es/convocatorias/dos-becas-de-investigacion-sedes-costa-rica-y-ecuador. So CALAS (+ Universitat Bielefeld) award this fellowship; Universidad de Guadalajara is only the host campus whose site republished the call. Every logo this host actually serves belongs to UdeG, with alt text 'Universidad de Guadalajara': /themes/drudg8b3/images/BG_escudo-header-01.svg (class logog) and /themes/drudg8b3/images/logo_udg_web_cads.svg (class logoch), plus /sites/default/files/favicon_0_0.ico. Reporting a UdeG shield would be precisely the rule 2 provenance error the brief names - a university mark standing in for a fellowship awarded by a different organisation. CALAS's real logo is published on calas.lat, which is a different registrable domain from cucsh.udg.mx, so rule 1 excludes it even though CALAS is physically hosted at CUCSH. What I did find and rejected: /sites/default/files/2026-08/bcihac-flacso27_facebook-copia-4.png, which I probed (HTTP 200, image/png) and rendered - it does contain the real CALAS mark (top left, 'CALAS / Maria Sibylla Merian Center') alongside the Universitat Bielefeld logo, but it is a 1200x1200 campaign poster reading 'CONVOCATORIA ABIERTA / FELLOWSHIPS CALAS 2027 / SEDE COSTA RICA Y SEDE ECUADOR / CIERRE DE CONVOCATORIA: 12 DE OCTUBRE DE 2026' on a dark navy field with white and pink type. That is per-call promotional artwork, not the awarding body's logo, and putting a dated poster on a scholarship card would be wrong. Also probed and rejected: https://www.cucsh.udg.mx/calas HTTP 404, and a site search turned up only CALAS news pages and other CALAS calls, with no standalone CALAS logo asset hosted here. Honest null: an acceptable mark exists, but not on a host this shard may use.
